newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom selects Lockheed for satellite.
newsitem.headline: Telkom selects Lockheed for satellite.

text.p: Telecommunication giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia has selected U.S. firm Lockheed Martin Corp to build its 36-transponder satellite to be launched next year, the Kompas newspaper reported on Thursday.
It quoted Doddy Amarudien, Telkom's vice president for corporate communications, as saying on Wednesday the satellite would replace the Palapa-B2R and would be named Satelit Telkom 1.
Amarudien said Telkom and Lockheed signed a letter of intent on Tuesday in Jakarta for construction of the satellite, scheduled for launching in late 1998.
Kompas said a contract would be signed in late March and that Lockheed had promise,d to build the satellite within 18 months.
Amarudien also said that Telkom needed 60 transponders in 2010 in line with the high growth of demand for telephone connections in Indonesia. The newspaper gave no further details.
The Palapa-B2R is one of the four Palapa-B satellite series operated by Telkom. Telkom is also listed in New York and London.
